state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad` and `Core\Ldap\Change` owe nothing.

**Every `Core\Ldap\Entry` member has its tests proof.** The Rust unit test `every_entry_reader_reads_its_own_form` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs` calls all 17 readers through `call` on an in-memory entry, and six `ldap-*.nvst` cases carry `covers:` lines for them. Each of the 17 still owes `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Entry'` lists them.

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded, and the root `[ldap.corp]` reaches it.** The `20-novis-seed` script in `tests/db/compose.yaml` writes `OU=Company` before Samba starts (its comment lists every user, group and password). The root `nvs.toml`'s `[ldap.corp]` binds over LDAPS at `localhost:16636` as the read-only `CN=Reader,OU=Company,DC=example,DC=test`. A proof program that opens it carries `// requires: samba-ad`, and a bench does too (`benches/members/README.md`). `docs/examples/core/Ldap/connect/` is the model for an example, an attack and a bench.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** `carla.diaz` has `mustChangePassword` and a computed `passwordExpired`, `dora.lind` is `disabled`, `ben.kohl` has `passwordNeverExpires`, `Newsletter` is a distribution group, and `Employees`/`Managers` are global security groups.

**Traps for a live proof.** A search returns entries in no fixed order, and GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot, so an example sorts what it prints and never prints those. A catch variable or a `var` reused in one file with another type does not compile (E0406): name each `LogicError` catch `$refusal` and each `Throwable` catch `$error`. An instance member's `covers:` line in a `.nvst` case goes at the end of the `--FILE--` block.

items.text: **The text readers `dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes` and `toArray` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). They are at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:682` to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:760`. Each program carries `// requires: samba-ad` and reads `OU=Company` through `[ldap.corp]`.

**The typed readers `int`, `bool`, `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration` and `isDeleted` owe nothing**, at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:85` to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:187` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:708`. An example never prints a GUID, SID or timestamp, only what it compares to.

**The AD readers `accountFlags`, `groupType` and `accountType` owe nothing**, at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:206` to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:248`, reading the seeded users and groups.

backlog: `Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` and `Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType` owe `about.md`, examples, an attack and a bench for every member (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/flags.rs`); their tests are paid.
`Core\Ldap\Entries` (`references`, `total`) and `Core\Ldap\Changes` (`cookie`) owe every proof, and a Rust `covers:` marker (`crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs`).
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies. Stage 6: wiring the schema into the readers.
